title: Orientation Lighthouse: multi-zone tour & empty-state asset kit
creator: Ava Romero
description: Design and deliver a cohesive first-run orientation pack called "Orientation Lighthouse" — a multi-zone interactive tour that guides new users through Workspace setup, Model Catalog discovery, Dedicated pool onboarding, and the Console home checklist. Deliverables: a) responsive tour frames and motion specs for 3 screen sizes, b) empty-state illustration library with 6 variants (workspace, models, routes, logs, billing, integrations), c) toolkit of microtips and truncated copy variants for A/B tests, d) final screenshot set for release notes and help docs. The focus is to reduce time-to-first-success while preserving minimal visual noise for power users. Designs must include accessibility tokens (contrast, font sizes), localization-ready copy, and annotation for engineering instrumentation hooks (events list).
acceptance_criteria: Tour frames: complete prototype in Figma with step flow for Account -> Workspace -> Model Catalog -> Dedicated Pools -> Quickstart run
Empty-state illustrations: exported SVG + PNG at 1x/2x for 6 contexts with alt text drafts
Microtip library: 12 copy variants and placement guidance (tooltip, inline, banner) with required character limits
Motion specs: 3 breakpoint animations (desktop, tablet, mobile) and performance budget notes
Accessibility: contrast checks and WCAG AA pass for text overlays, keyboard navigation notes for tour
Engineering handoff: annotated guide listing event names, sample payloads, and suggested sentinel attributes for analytics
Docs/screenshots: 10 annotated screenshots exported for release notes and knowledge base
tasks: Sketch initial flow + map user intents across Console surfaces
Create illustration concepts (3 directions) and run a quick studio review
Design tour UI shells and micro-interactions in Figma
Work with PM to prioritize microtip copy for the 1st-run checklist
Review with Engineering for feasibility and instrumentation plan
Export assets, prepare handoff package, and upload to Drive
Update release doc with final screenshots and file links

notes: Design trade-offs: kept tour unobtrusive by using a left-anchored docked stepper instead of full-screen modals to respect power-user workflows.
Localization: allowed 30% expansion in copy length; mockups include overflow behavior and line-clamp rules.
Empty-state approach: illustrations are thematic (beacon/lighthouse) but abstracted to avoid model-specific branding; we include subtle token patterns for enterprise feel.
Analytics: event names are snake_case and grouped under 'orientation_lighthouse' namespace for clarity in data warehouse.
Engineering constraints: on-prem builds may block animation frames; we provide a CSS-first fallback (reduced motion) and static PNGs.
Follow-ups: run a 1-week beta with 120 new signups and measure time-to-first-success and checklist completion rates.
